Our Curtain & Home Décor Services

From a single bedroom blind to a full villa makeover, we design, stitch, and install every detail — curtains, blinds, flooring, upholstery, and more.

How We Work

From your first call to the final installation, we keep things simple and stress-free. Here is what to expect when you choose K2 Curtains.

1

Free Home Consultation

Call or WhatsApp us to schedule a free home consultation. Our consultant arrives with a full range of fabric samples, catalogues, and measuring tools. We assess your windows, lighting, and existing décor while you browse colours and textures in your own home.
